svg.text: ALL VALUES IN mm. Estimated CAD geometry, not verified physical dimensions.
Edge labels are true 3D lengths; drawing extents are projected spans. SVG: hover any line for its edge length.
FLANGE PLAN - viewed normal to mounting face
SIDE - floor datum, hidden edges included
END - corrected lean, hidden edges included
Use viewer.html to click any CAD edge; Shift-click adds lengths.
Cyan flange lines: neighbouring hole centres, distances in mm.
Photo-derived approximation. Model precision is NOT manufacturing accuracy. No fabrication approval.
